`DeleteUser` removes the user but leaves lists they own in place, so `getList` dereferences a nil owner. Before choosing where to fix it, I'll check the list store and the git history.
The list's owner is never cleaned up when the account is deleted. I'll check the share package's membership and delete rules to see how orphaned lists should be handled.
There's already a `Lists.RemoveUser` meant for closing accounts. I'll check whether anything calls it.

`RemoveUser` is never called, so closing an account deletes the user but leaves their lists behind with a dangling owner. The root cause is in the account-closing handlers. Before writing a reproducer, I'll look at how the API tests are set up.
I'll write the reproducer as an API test: Bo owns a list, Ana is a member, Bo closes the account, then Ana requests the list. Before the fix, that request crashes.

{"title": "Closing an account leaves lists owned by that user, so GET /v1/lists/{id} panics for members", "fingerprint": "fp_37e633", "body": "Reports: cr_758b7f (x2, v1.4.0, commit 9c41e7a). Panic: nil pointer dereference in api.(*API).getList at api/lists.go:63 (owner.Name), on GET /v1/lists/lst_0001.

Cause: api.(*API).closeAccount (api/users.go) calls Store.DeleteUser, which removes the user, but never removes the lists that user owns. share.Lists.RemoveUser exists to do this (deletes the owned lists and removes the user from other lists) but nothing calls it. The list lst_0001 keeps Owner=usr_bo after usr_bo is gone. getList then calls a.Store.User(l.Owner), ignores the error, gets nil, and dereferences it. Logs show usr_bo closed the account at 12:20:10, and a GET of lst_0001 panicked at 15:21.

Fix: closeAccount and the admin deleteUser handler (api/admin.go) now call a.Lists.RemoveUser after Store.DeleteUser, so no list is left with a missing owner.

Reproducer: api/close_account_test.go, TestGetListAfterOwnerClosesAccount. It fails on the old code with status 500 and passes now.", "root_cause": {"file": "api/users.go", "function": "(*API).closeAccount"}}
